steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Grate the zucchini coarsely, then squeeze firmly in a clean towel to remove excess water.
In a large bowl, mash the cooked lentils with a fork until mostly smooth.
Add the grated zucchini, minced garlic, chickpea flour, coconut milk, cumin, and turmeric to the bowl.
Stir until the mixture holds together; if too wet, add 15 g more chickpea flour.
Shape into 16 small patties, about 4 cm wide, and place on the lined baking sheet.
Brush the tops lightly with olive oil.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes, flipping once at 12 minutes, until golden and firm.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving; refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days or freeze for 1 month.
